description.text: The other BW8 expansion, released on 14 December 2012 alongside Spiral Force, with the legendary Thundurus in its Therian Forme on the wrapper. The two packs build up the Team Plasma cards begun in Plasma Gale: Deoxys, Thundurus and Tornadus in Therian Forme, and every evolution of Eevee appear as Team Plasma Pokémon. Thunder Knuckle's Pokémon-EX are Thundurus-EX, Tornadus-EX and Latias-EX. The cards are numbered to 51. In English most of its cards came out in Plasma Freeze in May 2013.
